context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

Our spans come from LiteLLM's otel callback. Prompts are there but gen_ai.output.messages is missing on streamed calls only. Should we write our own instrumentation?

checklist.name: known-litellm-streaming-bug
checklist.description: Identifies this as a known LiteLLM otel callback issue scoped to streamed calls, and recommends checking the installed version's changelog / upgrading once it's fixed.

checklist.name: record-as-upstream-gap
checklist.description: Records the missing responses as an upstream gap in the report, with the library named as the owner.

checklist.name: no-hand-rolled-emitter
checklist.description: Does not recommend hand-writing spans or adding a second span source on the same call path. FAIL if it proposes either.
